text: A rule checklist for Evitania Online, filled in by hand. Your stage sets which tier of each system is expected, and each system lists its tiers.
Pick your stage at the top. Set your tier for each system with the plus and minus buttons, or open a system and click the highest tier you have reached.
The requirement is a target or recommendation stated in the source.
The requirement is a game threshold, cost or unlock reported by the source.
Ordered or set from several sources; no single guide states it as a target. Treat it as a draft.
The expected tier at each stage is a synthesis of the guides, not a community standard.
Since game version 0.311.0 the save file is encrypted and the developers ask players not to share ways to decode it, so tiers are set by hand.

Built 2026-11-15 from sources dated April to November 2026, around game version 0.323.1. Numbers marked Game data were re-checked on 2026-11-14 against the wiki data files and the developer patch notes. All sources are unofficial; check values in-game after patches.

Guild research, the Tower, fishing (event mini-game so far) and the Hourglass Restoration of Eternity tabs have no tiers here: the guides for them are thin or not written yet. Trinkets have a first draft.
